evals.name: printf-json-injection
evals.expected_output: Flag CRITICAL — JSON injection via printf format string in JSON construction. Recommend jq --arg for safe JSON construction.
evals.root_cause_tested: injection — tests whether skill detects printf-based JSON injection

assertions.name: identifies_injection
assertions.description: Identifies printf JSON injection risk as CRITICAL

assertions.name: recommends_jq
assertions.description: Recommends jq --arg for safe JSON construction

evals.name: eval-command-injection
evals.prompt: Script uses eval "$cmd" where cmd is built from user input via cmd="git commit -m $message"
evals.expected_output: Flag CRITICAL — command injection via eval with variable input. Suggest array-based command construction.
evals.root_cause_tested: injection — tests whether skill detects eval-based command injection

assertions.name: flags_eval
assertions.description: Flags eval with variable input as CRITICAL security issue

assertions.name: suggests_arrays
assertions.description: Suggests array-based command construction as the safe alternative

evals.name: missing-set-flags
evals.prompt: Bash script starts with #!/bin/bash and no set flags, then proceeds to process files
evals.expected_output: Flag missing set -euo pipefail header. Recommend #!/usr/bin/env bash with set -euo pipefail.
evals.root_cause_tested: header — tests whether skill catches missing error handling flags

assertions.name: identifies_missing_flags
assertions.description: Identifies missing set -euo pipefail error handling flags

assertions.name: recommends_pipefail
assertions.description: Recommends the full set -euo pipefail header

evals.name: temp-file-secrets-no-cleanup
evals.prompt: Script writes API keys to /tmp/creds.txt without trap cleanup: echo "$API_KEY" > /tmp/creds.txt
evals.expected_output: Flag HIGH — hardcoded tmp path (use mktemp), no trap cleanup, secrets written to temp file.
evals.root_cause_tested: temp_files — tests whether skill catches temp file misuse with secrets

assertions.name: flags_hardcoded_tmp
assertions.description: Flags hardcoded /tmp path and recommends mktemp

assertions.name: flags_missing_trap
assertions.description: Flags missing trap for cleanup on EXIT

assertions.name: flags_secrets_in_tmp
assertions.description: Flags writing secrets/API keys to temp files

evals.name: unquoted-path-in-rm
evals.prompt: Script uses rm $file_path without quotes in a loop over user-provided filenames
evals.expected_output: Flag HIGH — unquoted path variable in destructive command. Word splitting could cause unintended deletion.
evals.root_cause_tested: path_safety — tests whether skill catches unquoted variables in destructive commands

assertions.name: identifies_unquoted
assertions.description: Identifies unquoted variable in destructive rm command
